methods.name: public static final byte[] decodeQuotedPrintable(byte[] bytes)
methods.comment:
* Decodes an array quoted-printable characters into an array of original bytes. * Escaped characters are converted back to their original representation. * *

* This function implements a subset of * quoted-printable encoding specification (rule #1 and rule #2) * as defined in RFC 1521. *

* * @param bytes array of quoted-printable characters * @return array of original bytes, * null if quoted-printable decoding is unsuccessful.

methodNames: public static final byte[] decodeQuotedPrintable(byte[] bytes)
